body:
I have been testing on Calea for a few weeks now. Nothing really interesting has occured but I can say that this herb works. First of all, don't smoke it in large quantities and drink milk at the same time (before going to bed, that is). You will probably lose most of the nights sleep. I smoked three joints, drank a large glass of milk and didn't sleep at all that night. I don't know if this is the case for you, maybe it's just me.
But when I smoke one small bowl stuffed tight, I immediately notice a certain relaxation and a nice calming down. Dreams may be a little clearer than usual, but I really can't tell, 'cause I normally have very vivid and clear dreams + remembering them afterwards is not a problem. I remember about three dreams per night without Calea and with it about four... All I really need is some lucidity in my dreams. That has not (yet) happened.
